query: Given this restaurant opening hours string: 12:00 PM - 2:30 PM, 7:00 PM - 10:30 PM, open on Mondays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays. Determine if the restaurant is generally open for dinner hours (around 19:00-22:00) on most days. Respond with open_for_dinner True if open during dinner most days, else False.
